notes: The italicized 'house' is folded onto ἀρχισυναγώγου as the completion of an elliptical genitive, on rule 52's pattern; marking it added under rule 103 remains defensible, but no other token is spent for it to belong to.
The subordinator 'While' goes to the participle that carries the subordination (rule 86), leaving Ἔτι its own 'yet'.
